title: Fed Governor Michael Barr signals more rate hikes needed to tame inflation

title: HSBC lifts STOXX 600 year-end target on stronger earnings outlook

Enhanced business optimism and diminished geopolitical worries have supported this optimistic perspective for European equities. While Italy's market outlook was upgraded, France's forecast faced downgrading due to unfavorable projections.
